verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe built-in i18n support for translating a Docusaurus website, out-of-the-box localization through git, Crowdin or other translation managers, per-locale deployment, and RTL locale support. That clearly covers publishing docs in multiple languages. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that navigation elements (navbar, sidebar labels) are translatable, deeper documentation of the translation workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the i18n feature.
